info.title: RealtyPals Backend API
info.description: AI-powered real estate advisor backend API. Provides endpoints for chat, property discovery, lead management, analytics, and admin operations.

post.description: Core chat endpoint for conversational AI. Handles text messages, intent patches, comparisons, and tool requests. Supports both authenticated users and anonymous guests.
